text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E at a large gain felt satisfying, but one successful sale does not show that I can predict prices; past moves still do not forecast future returns.","The account fell in Periods 9 and 10 after rising earlier, reminding me that short-term swings are normal; I should not trade merely to avoid the discomfort of a loss or to lock in gains.","I should review each holding objectively against risk and diversification, rather than let my reluctance to admit a mistake or my satisfaction from a gain dictate whether I buy, sell, or hold."]}
